light_description: Japanese handmade overdrive and a long-running core Shigemori model; dealer records describe it as a downsized evolution of STONEDRIVE, with bright natural drive, strong picking response and a machined high-purity aluminum enclosure.
Low-gain-focused Shigemori drive with added BASS control; documented as an evolution of RUBY STONE with broader range and a distinct low-gain/preamp/boost role.
Marshall-style drive with broad gain range and TIGHT/DEEP voicing; official SHINOS documentation records a 2023 enclosure refresh while retaining the first-generation sound concept.
Transparent-style natural overdrive with TIGHT/DEEP switching, documented by SHINOS as a drive pedal with enough gain for standalone distortion and amp boosting.
British-style medium-to-high-gain drive with a wide gain range from natural drive through deep distortion; preserved as a separate Blue Tongue Series dirt model.
Handmade Japanese drive designed around a creamy, deep distortion character; official catalog documents a JRC4558DV vintage version, vintage germanium transistor matching and three-band EQ.
RED presentation of the 007 CREAMY DRIVE; official catalog identifies it as the RED version of the original model while retaining its core drive architecture and three-band EQ.
Premium/vintage-parts drive with three-band EQ and variable mids; official catalog describes JRC4558DV vintage-version op-amp and vintage germanium transistor pairing for soft distortion.
Current TDC-YOU handmade dirt/boost catalog model; retained as a central candidate pending deeper historical chronology and photo/specimen reconciliation.
